name: Helton
title: Blacksmith

trainer/30678.htm.text: Blacksmith Helton: Hmmph, who are you? Why did you come here? Unless you've brought a keg of beer, I have no time to spare in idle chatter. Heat it, heat it, bake it, cool it down! That's my craft! Through fire and water, I fashion stout armor and blades sharp enough to cut the wind itself. What do…
trainer/30678.htm.dpText: Blacksmith Helton: Hmph, who are you? Why did you come here? I don't want to deal with you unless you've brought a case of delicious dwarven beer. Shoot, heat it, heat it, bake it, and cool it down! I want to make it too! Brilliant armor, and a blade that can cut the wind! Man, how irritating...

trainer/30678-4.htm.text: Blacksmith Helton: Hmph. It's true. You can seal or remove a seal here. But it's annoying.

links.text: Release seal on B-grade gloves and boots.

trainer/30678-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Helton: You can augment an item or remove augment here. Finish up and leave.

trainer/30678-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Helton: Hey, wake up! I only teach Artisans and Warsmiths. You are not worthy to be my student!

Q00337_AudienceWithTheLandDragon/30678-0.text: Blacksmith Helton: Good job! You have bought us some time. Alas, it is nothing more than a temporary respite... The root of these problems is Antharas. No one in the eastern region will rest easily until he is dealt with. Here is your Proof of Guardian.

Blacksmith Helton: At long last, Gabrielle has sent someone. I belong to the Black Anvil Guild but originally trained as a seal guardian under Filaur of the Gray Pillar Guild. You may not know this, but recently a decisive battle was fought between our brave warriors and the Succubus. They were try…
Blacksmith Helton: Naturally, Warehouse Chief Moke of Gludin Village is guarding the column. Please go to him. He could probably use some help right now from a person like yourself.
Blacksmith Helton: Thanks to your efforts our columns in Gludin and Oren have been saved. Now go back to Gabrielle . She will have another task for you. May Maphr smile upon you!

Blacksmith Helton: Basically, an Abyssal Jewel is a device that absorbs the ambient magic of darkness. The succubus gang is using that power to destroy the aura that binds Antharas. There is no time to waste, for if this well-rested beast is allowed to escape it will be disastrous. Do you understan…

common/duals_02.htm.text: You may already know this, but our store is different from other stores in the region. We combine high-grade weapons to create Dualswords. We are able to combine almost every type of sword. If we can't...well, then you should go to the capital or seek out the Blacksmith of Mammon. You never know...…

common/weapon_sa_01.htm.text: Ah, so you wish to enhance your weapon! Well, it's the next-best thing to buying a new one, I say... But remember, a higher price doesn't necessarily mean a better product. There are many excellent weapons that are reasonably priced. As I'm sure you know, capabilities added to your weapon don't int…

common/crafting_01.htm.text: [Create ingredient item] Our Blacksmith Guild creates items at a very reasonable price. You may entrust your precious materials to our Blacksmiths. They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

common/augmentation_01.htm.text: Augmenting means give energy to weapons or accessories. Augmenting is simple, but it isn't always accurate. A few days ago, a mysterious ore called Life Stone, which has a very similar characteristic to Soul Crystals, was found in Black Anvil. If you bring this Life Stone and some other necessities…

links.text: Exchange Life Stone for augmenting accesorries.

common/augmentation_02.htm.text: You wish to remove the refined Life Stone? That's fine. But understand that this smelting method offers both improvement and potential penalties. It is difficult to restore the original weapon when removing the Life Stone. It requires a special chemical process and a special tool. It's also expensi…

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
